notes: All the States and UTs had reported very high proportion of undertrial prisoners. In
general, the percentage of Undertrials to total jail inmates ranged from 52.7% to 93.9%.
The lowest percentage of undertrial prisoners was reported from Madhya Pradesh (52.7%).
The percentage of Mentally ill was considerably low in the country. The maximum
percentage of 1.7 of such inmates was reported from UT of A&N Islands.
